svg.title: AWS Foundation and Security — Service Study Map
svg.desc: Notebook-style portrait mind map with eight colour-coded AWS foundation and security domains, each with three learning topics.
svg.text: AWS accounts · identity · governance · secrets · encryption · cost controls
MFA enabled; no root access keys
Grant only required actions and resources
Control which principals can assume roles
Set maximum permissions for IAM identities
Attach an IAM role to an EC2 workload
Authorize workloads to access S3 and APIs
Manage keys, grants and key policies
Group accounts into OUs for governance
Set permission ceilings; SCPs do not grant
Central workforce access to AWS accounts
Set cost and usage thresholds with alerts
Notify on spend changes; not a hard spend
Use cost allocation tags and account-level
Follow each numbered branch from the central topic. Cards are learning themes and key AWS concepts, not a deployment sequence.
Validate service behaviour, quotas and pricing against current AWS documentation before implementation.
AWS MASTER VAULT • FOUNDATION & SECURITY • LEARNING MAP
